Sinestro Corps

Karu-Sil

A fear-wielder with a ring-made animal pack.

Karu-Sil is a Sinestro Corps fighter whose yellow constructs form an animal pack. Her story connects personal attachment with the terror she inflicts on others.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Sinestro Corps
First appearance
Green Lantern #19 (2007)
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

Karu-Sil grows up among predators on Graxos III after losing her parents. The beasts become her family, giving her later ring-made pack meaning beyond convenient weapons. Her homeworld is not Arisia’s Graxos IV: they are different planets in the same system. Green Lantern #19’s backup introduces her history before the Sinestro Corps War.

Key Stories

  • Sinestro Corps War
    Sinestro Corps Special #1; Green Lantern #21–25; Green Lantern Corps #14–19 (2007)
